challenge.method: Checked whether the copyright attribution, dated change note, or later GStreamer licensing FAQ could replace the authority named in the grant.
challenge.results: Bastien Nocera appears in the copyright line and Christian Schaller in the change note. The operative sentence identifies the Totem project as grantor. The dated header supplies the original wording directly. Its reference to license_change is an additional lead.

limitations: Historical describes the Index’s treatment of this dated witness. The supplied 1.0.5 edition is bound here to the specified header digest. A separate Totem release-tag object was outside the named evidence.
The finding covers the Totem header and named combination. GStreamer’s library license, individual plugin licenses, and other project files require their own evidence.
reasoning: GNOME’s pinned src/totem.h names the Totem project as granting permission for “non-gpl compatible GStreamer plugins to be used and distributed together with GStreamer and Totem.” It calls the permission additional to Totem’s GPL permissions. The following note credits Christian Schaller with adding the clause on Monday 7 February 2005. This identifies the original provision for the Index’s historical mapping.
